turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Nice to meet you, Leo. How are you?

turns.speaker: Leo

turns.speaker: Maya

turns.speaker: Leo

turns.speaker: Maya

scenes.purpose: Understand the overall situation without written or narrated spoilers

beats.teacherSpeech: هتسمع دلوقتي حوار قصير بين اتنين. ركّز في سبب كلامهم مع بعض، مش كل كلمة. مش لازم تفهم كل حاجة من أول مرة.
اسمع الحوار كامل. ولو محتاج تسمعه تاني، استخدم زر إعادة الاستماع.
دلوقتي اختار وصف الموقف اللي سمعته. الإجابة مش موجودة على البورد.

options.text: Two friends discuss an English class they finished.
A teacher introduces the class to a student.
options.misconception: Teacher/student instead of two new classmates

options.text: Two people meet before an English class.

assessment.correctFeedbackAr: صح. هما بيتعرفوا قبل كلاس إنجليزي. عرفت ده من سؤال الاسم وحديثهم عن الكلاس، مش من شكل البورد.

wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.talk-last-class: هم بيتكلموا قبل بداية الكلاس، مش عن كلاس خلص. اسمع عبارة excited about our English class، وبعدين See you inside.
wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.teacher-intro: الاتنين بيتعرفوا على بعض كزمايل، ومفيش حد فيهم بيشرح الكلاس. اسمع What's your name? وMy name is Leo.

scenes.purpose: Understand and use greetings and name exchange in a first meeting

beats.teacherSpeech: نسمع أول تلات جمل تاني، وبعدين ناخد التحية والاسم واحدة واحدة.
Maya بدأت Good morning، تحية بنقولها الصبح. Leo رد Hi. الاتنين طرق طبيعية لبدء الكلام.
Maya قالت I'm Maya، وLeo قال My name is Leo. الاتنين بيقولوا الاسم. I'm اختصار I am؛ مش محتاجين جدول قواعد كامل دلوقتي.
Maya سألت What's your name? يعني اسمك إيه؟ عشان تسأل عن اسم حد، استخدم نفس السؤال؛ ولما تجاوب قول اسمك أنت.
جرّب تميّز سؤال الاسم عن سؤال الحال في موقف مختلف.

assessment.promptAr: إنت عايز تسأل زميل جديد عن اسمه. هتقول إيه؟

options.misconception: Asks about a third person's name instead

assessment.correctFeedbackAr: بالضبط. What's your name? معناها اسمك إيه؟ وبعدها ممكن الشخص يقول I'm Sara أو My name is Sara.

wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.how-you: How are you? معناها إزيك، مش اسمك إيه. سؤال الاسم هو What's your name?
wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.name-of-teacher: What's the teacher's name? بيسأل عن اسم المدرس، مش الشخص اللي قدامك. قول What's your name?

scenes.purpose: Recognize and contrast ordinary wellbeing replies and first-day feelings

beats.teacherSpeech: نسمع تاني الجزء اللي بيسألوا فيه عن الحال. اسمع رد Leo ورد Maya، وبعدين هنفهم الفرق.
How are you? يعني إزيك؟ السؤال هنا عن حالك، مش عن اسمك.
Leo رد Pretty good, thanks؛ يعني كويس إلى حد كبير، شكرًا. Maya قالت Really good, thank you؛ يعني كويسة جدًا، شكرًا. دي ردود طبيعية، مش درجات لازم تحفظ ترتيبها.
Leo قال I'm feeling excited about our English class، يعني أنا حاسس بحماس للكلاس. Maya كمان قالت I'm excited, too. Excited إحساس بالحماس، وfeeling هنا بمعنى حاسس.
Thanks وThank you للتعبير عن الشكر. وAnd you? بترجع نفس السؤال للشخص التاني.
دلوقتي اختار معنى رد مناسب في موقف جديد.

assessment.promptAr: زميلة بتقول Really good, thank you. هي تقصد إيه؟

options.text: I'm feeling very good. Thank you.

assessment.correctFeedbackAr: مظبوط. Really good هنا معناها إني كويسة جدًا، وThank you للشكر. الرد مش سؤال عن الاسم.

wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.name-good: الكلام هنا عن حالها، مش اسمها. Really good يعني كويسة جدًا.
wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.asks-about-you: الجملة رد عن حالها، مش سؤال. السؤال نفسه How are you?

scenes.purpose: Read a different short written class note independently

beats.teacherSpeech: دلوقتي في ورقة قصيرة من الكلاس. اقراها بنفسك من غير ما أقولك محتواها، وبعدها جاوب.
beats.readText:
WELCOME TO ENGLISH CLASS
Meet new people.
Write your name on this card.
Introduce yourself to one person.
Thank you!

beats.teacherSpeech: اختار مين المطلوب منه يعرّف بنفسه حسب التعليمات المكتوبة.

assessment.promptAr: الورقة بتقول Introduce yourself. مين المفروض يعرّف بنفسه؟

options.text: A different classmate will introduce you.
You introduce yourself to another person.

assessment.correctFeedbackAr: صح. Introduce yourself يعني عرّف بنفسك أنت. الورقة بتطلب منك تقول اسمك لشخص تاني.

wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.new-classmate: التعليمات بتقول yourself؛ المقصود أنت اللي تعرّف بنفسك، مش حد يعملها بدالك.
wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.the-teacher: المطلوب منك أنت، مش من المدرس فقط. كلمة yourself هنا بتشير لنفس الشخص اللي بياخد التعليمات.

scenes.purpose: Optional bounded alternative wellbeing reply, not a second story

beats.teacherSpeech: فيه رد طبيعي تاني لسؤال How are you؟ اسمع الجملة دي: I'm tired today. وخمّن معناها.
اختار المعنى المناسب للجملة القصيرة اللي سمعتها.

assessment.promptAr: حد قال I'm tired today. ده معناه إيه؟

options.text: I don't have much energy today.

assessment.correctFeedbackAr: بالضبط. Tired يعني تعبان أو محتاج راحة. ده رد ممكن تسمعه على How are you؟

wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.very-excited: Excited معناها متحمس. Tired معناها تعبان.
wrongFeedbackByOptionAr.feels-fine: Pretty good معناها كويس، أما tired معناها تعبان أو مجهد.

scenes.purpose: Listen/repeat question intonation and short clear A1 phrases; don't confuse echo with independent mastery

beats.teacherSpeech: اسمع How are you? تاني، ولاحظ نبرة السؤال. وبعدها جرّب تقولها بصوتك؛ لو الميكروفون مش متاح، هنعتبر التدريب مش متقيّم.
دلوقتي قول How are you? وسجّل المحاولة لو الميكروفون شغال. بعد كده جرّب Thanks بنبرة لطيفة. مش هسجل إتقان نطق من مجرد ضغط زر.

scenes.purpose: Independent fresh first contact + separate short changed moments for phrase and feeling evidence

beats.teacherSpeech: هتقابل زميل جديد اسمه Sam في صباح يوم مختلف. اتكلم معاه بالإنجليزي من غير جمل جاهزة على البورد: سلّم، عرّف بنفسك، اسأل عن اسمه وحاله، ورد بأدب.
بعد التعارف، هنجرب مواقف قصيرة جديدة: زميل بيسألك عن حالك قبل الكلاس، وبعد الكلاس، وبعدها عن إحساسك باليوم. كل مرة تجاوب بطريقتك.

requiredVisualStates: Every boardStateId is a semantic SVG/React IMPLEMENTATION SPEC only; no visuals yet coded/QA
assessmentDisclosurePolicy: Questions never appear with keyed feedback until after a learner response

boardStates.title: Listen first
boardStates.visualIntent: Two unlabeled speaker silhouettes and a neutral waveform; no class/greeting/location/answer text.
boardStates.altText: Listen to two unidentified speakers.
boardStates.portrait: Use vertically stacked figures, keep Otti lower-right clear.
boardStates.landscape: Use left/right speakers and centered play strip.

boardStates.title: Audio active
boardStates.visualIntent: Waveform plus two speaker indicators, disabled answer cards; spoken-source transcript remains hidden until response.
boardStates.altText: Recorded two-speaker dialogue is playing.
boardStates.portrait: Place large replay/status line above safe-zone.
boardStates.landscape: Place player at center with wide margins.

boardStates.title: What is happening?
boardStates.visualIntent: Only the 3 authored balanced answer cards, no audio transcript or source hints.
boardStates.altText: Choose what the speakers are doing.
boardStates.portrait: Cards stacked; no scroll inside board.

boardStates.title: Hear greetings
boardStates.visualIntent: Two unnamed speech bubbles with playback indicator; no word labels before replay.
boardStates.altText: Replay the greetings and names.

boardStates.title: Morning greeting
boardStates.visualIntent: Sunrise icon by Maya; greeting arrow to Leo; reveal Good morning and Hi only with Otti narration.
boardStates.altText: Morning greeting followed by Hi.

boardStates.title: Names
boardStates.visualIntent: Identity badges with Maya / Leo and their distinct I'm / My name is expressions.
boardStates.altText: Maya says I'm Maya; Leo says My name is Leo.

boardStates.title: Name question
boardStates.visualIntent: What's your name? points to empty learner name slot, not an already chosen correct answer.
boardStates.altText: A question invites the other person's name.
boardStates.landscape: Question left, blank name card right.

boardStates.title: Choose question
boardStates.visualIntent: Only authored name-question options; no board marking right answer.
boardStates.altText: Select which English question asks a classmate's name.

boardStates.title: Listen for replies
boardStates.visualIntent: Question symbol plus two blank speaker-answer bubbles during replay, no pretty/really labels yet.
boardStates.altText: Listen to two wellbeing replies.

boardStates.title: How are you
boardStates.visualIntent: How are you? question and arrows to two possible replies; answer text still hidden until next beat.
boardStates.altText: Question How are you? with two possible responses.

boardStates.title: Two natural replies
boardStates.visualIntent: Leo pretty good, thanks versus Maya really good, thank you. No ranked mastery meter.
boardStates.altText: Two natural positive wellbeing replies.

boardStates.title: Excited about class
boardStates.visualIntent: Single student's speech and class icon with 'I'm feeling excited'; show Maya's 'I'm excited, too' as response.
boardStates.altText: A first-day student feels excited.
boardStates.portrait: One labeled bubble at a time.
boardStates.landscape: Two bubbles with shared class icon.

boardStates.title: Polite answer
boardStates.visualIntent: Speech exchange: Thanks/Thank you then And you? return arrow.
boardStates.altText: A thank-you followed by a return question.

boardStates.title: How is she?
boardStates.visualIntent: Three authored choices with equally weighted typography; no answer marked before grading.
boardStates.altText: Select the meaning of Really good, thank you.

boardStates.title: Class note
boardStates.visualIntent: A paper card with the exact accessible SELECTABLE English text; no Otti recitation, no answer highlight.
boardStates.altText: A welcome note asks the student to meet people, write their name and introduce themselves.
boardStates.portrait: Readable real text in portrait paper panel.
boardStates.landscape: Paper and accessible real text panel.

boardStates.title: Read and choose
boardStates.visualIntent: Keep written note readable while presenting multiple-choice options; no highlighted answer.
boardStates.altText: Choose who should introduce themselves.
boardStates.portrait: Text then answer cards; permit page scroll but no board internal scroll.
boardStates.landscape: Text left, answer cards right without masking.

boardStates.title: Hear tired
boardStates.visualIntent: Single source sentence played via Otti, neutral face outlines; NO sleepy icon/translation before answer.
boardStates.altText: Listen to one alternative wellbeing reply.

boardStates.title: Tired meaning
boardStates.visualIntent: Three plausible wellbeing meanings, with no correct-state decorations before click.
boardStates.altText: Choose the meaning of I'm tired.

boardStates.title: Sound of question
boardStates.visualIntent: Simple pitch curve only, with 'How are you?' after clip, not pretending to measure microphone pitch.
boardStates.altText: A spoken English question with illustrative rising/connected intonation.
boardStates.portrait: Static line graph with accessible labels.
boardStates.landscape: Static line graph with accessible labels.

boardStates.title: Your spoken attempt
boardStates.visualIntent: Microphone readiness status, question text optionally once playback ended; no artificial pass confetti.
boardStates.altText: Learner is invited to repeat How are you and Thanks.
boardStates.landscape: Mic target next to centered speaking prompt.

boardStates.title: Meet Sam
boardStates.visualIntent: New fictional character only, NO modeled target phrase anywhere on board.
boardStates.altText: A new person is ready to meet the student.
boardStates.portrait: One character with clear input zone.
boardStates.landscape: Two facing characters with safe input zone.

boardStates.title: Different situations
boardStates.visualIntent: Small class-door and end-of-class pictograms without target words; prompts are spoken.
boardStates.altText: After-meeting situations invite new responses.

syncContract.speechToBoard: Board state enters with the named authored beat; no word-level promise for Live Otti.
syncContract.teacherVoice: Exact beat teacherSpeech via Gemini Live, wait for PCM actually drained before advancing.
syncContract.sourceAudio: Factory WAV only after owner-approved new edition; transcript/vtt/timestamps derived from actual rendered bytes.
syncContract.audioToMic: Mic closed before starting/while playing source WAV, opened only for voice attempt/Speaking; no captured WAV as learner speech.
syncContract.playbackFailure: fail-closed with retry, no fake listened/graded state
syncContract.singleStepAdvance: one audible completion at most one authored beat
syncContract.clipValidation: ordered non-overlapping turn boundaries, reviewed containment, exact source version, no invented ms
syncContract.quiz: Choice IDs immutable, right/wrong feedback read after response and PCM completion; preserve wrong answer attempt
syncContract.wordSync: Only prerecorded source audio with audited timestamps can be word-synced; Live Otti is beat-synced
syncContract.interruption: Cancel stale callbacks, never double-complete or open mic during source PCM
